description: Deletes a story submitted to Plot Speaks (pending or published) when its submission id and claim code match. On the account connector, a signed-in writer can withdraw their own story with just the id.

claim_code.description: The claim code from the receipt, e.g. ABCD-EFGH-JKMN. Needed unless the writer is signed in on the account connector and the story is theirs.

id.description: The submission id from the receipt

name: withdraw_submission
title: Withdraw a submission
